baseline_definition: Production carry-forward OW forecast available before reported previews; Friday-Sunday opening weekend only.
decision_rule: Promoted for non-AMC Live-Friday baseline after downstream paired influence audit; AMC-plus-preview remains shadow-only.
minimum_history_rule: Post-2022 expanding historical diagnostics required at least 20 prior preview movies before scoring.
preview_definition: Observed final reported Thursday preview gross; used only as an information signal and never added to opening weekend gross.

production_usage.actual_reported_preview: Rescale Live-Friday/Saturday/Sunday baseline OW prior when leakage-safe preview actual and baseline are available.
production_usage.amc_thursday_preview: Shadow-only nowcast path; never affects production point forecast until separately validated.
production_usage.friday_amc: Unchanged; Friday AMC nowcast replaces Friday component only while Saturday/Sunday retain preview-updated baseline scale.
